title: Twas the prudent member
html_source:
That would be Bloom. Joe hints that Bloom is a freemason. The secrecy of freemasonry was supposedly protected by members refraining from “imprudent” speech.

This is a casual anti-Semitic remark resting on a (false) theory that conspiracies of Jewish people, through shadowy organizations, pursue nefarious purposes.

Whether Bloom is/was actually a freemason is a question Joyce leaves open to debate.
